```python
def minPathSum(grid):
    m, n = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for i in range(m):
        for j in range(n):
            if i == 0 and j == 0:
                continue
            elif i == 0:
                grid[i][j] += grid[i][j - 1]
            elif j == 0:
                grid[i][j] += grid[i - 1][j]
            else:
                grid[i][j] += min(grid[i - 1][j], grid[i][j - 1])
    return grid[-1][-1]
```
